title: Payment API primary database failover
resolution_summary: Replica promoted successfully. Root cause: disk I/O saturation on primary.

title: Fraud detection model returning 100% approve rate
resolution_summary: Feature pipeline outage caused all-zero feature vectors. Fallback rule engine activated. Model retrained.

title: Customer portal returning 502 errors intermittently
resolution_summary: Bad deployment rolled back. Certificate misconfiguration in nginx.

title: Ledger reconciliation showing $0.03 discrepancy across 1,200 accounts
resolution_summary: Floating-point rounding error introduced in ledger service v2.3.1. Corrected via migration script after legal review.

title: Notification service messages delayed by 45 minutes
resolution_summary: RabbitMQ queue depth exceeded alert threshold. Consumer group scaled up.

title: Unauthorized API access attempt on payment-api detected
resolution_summary: Credential stuffing attack from 3 IPs. IPs blocklisted, session tokens rotated. No data exfiltrated.

title: KYC service unable to reach identity verification partner API
resolution_summary: Egress firewall rule inadvertently blocked during routine maintenance. Rule restored.

title: Reporting dashboard ETL job failing silently since last deployment
resolution_summary: Schema change in upstream data warehouse not reflected in ETL job. Schema mapping updated.

title: Payment API p99 latency degraded from 120ms to 4200ms
resolution_summary: Connection pool exhaustion due to slow queries after index drop. Index recreated, pool settings tuned.

title: Core banking ledger service OOM crash — all transactions halted
resolution_summary: Memory leak in ledger service v2.4.0 caused OOM kill. Service restarted on v2.3.9. Memory profiling task opened.

title: Shared load balancer health checks failing — multiple services impacted
resolution_summary: HAProxy configuration corrupted during automated cert renewal. Config restored from backup.

title: Fraud detection false-negative spike — 23% of fraudulent transactions approved
resolution_summary: Model drift detected after new merchant category codes were added without retraining. Emergency retraining completed.
